## Triage: p1 · `target:v18` · `area:access` · `domain:engine` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-18T11:56Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Fresh read on `origin/main` `52ff308b86`:**
  - `ObjectRegistry.registerObject` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, about `:3088`) runs `applySystemFields` on the body it registers;
  - the injected-columns plan (`packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-columns.ts:206`) opts out only when that body itself says `managedBy: 'better-auth'`.
  So an extension body, which carries no `managedBy`, is planned as an ordinary object. The premise holds.
- **Grade p1 + `target:v18`.**
  - An app-level `objectExtensions` entry on a platform identity object silently makes an organization unreadable to its own owner and members.
  - It also adds physical columns to a better-auth table, which is harder to undo after release than before.
  - Both fix routes are a registry behaviour change in the 18.0 window.
- **For the lane:** `sys_user` is named and unmeasured. It is the common case (apps add fields to users), so measure it in the same round. The choice between "inherit the target's plan" and "refuse a `lock: 'full'` target" is the lane's, with its four-axis reasoning.
- objectstack-ai/cloud#3014 found this. That card's seat recommends not extending `sys_organization` at all (its option A), and this card stands either way.

An `objectExtensions` entry on a better-auth-managed object must no longer leave the merged object with injected system columns that hide every organisation from its own owner and members. The route between "inherit the target's injection plan" and "refuse an extension of a `lock: 'full'` target" is settled by measurement and the four axes, and `sys_user` is measured in the same round.

File surface:
- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: the `objectExtensions` registration path (`registerObject` and the extension loop) and its `applySystemFields` call. An extension is either judged by its target's declaration or refused against it.
- If the refusal route is taken: the fixtures that extend a `lock: 'full'` object only to exercise something else get a non-locked target, each named in the report. A fixture under `packages/spec` is declared to `domain:spec` by the seat before the PR enters the queue.
- Pins beside each, including one on a booted multi-tenant kernel, and one changeset per package touched, `.changeset/24314-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-columns.ts`: the plan is reused, and the target's declaration is handed to it from the registry. Not `packages/platform-objects` (no lock or `managedBy` is changed), no new error code, no migration of existing columns. Stop on any other breach and explain it in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud` (measured on a booted multi-tenant kernel: owner, member and control reads of the extended object, for `sys_organization` and `sys_user`), `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no (narrowing) (provisional: the refusal route narrows what a package may register. If the inherit route ships instead, the dev reports it and the seat re-declares this line. Either way one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review is owed before the queue.)
Responsibility: `ObjectRegistry.registerObject` runs `applySystemFields` on the extension body, and the injected-columns plan opts out only when that body itself says `managedBy: 'better-auth'`, so the merged better-auth table gains `organization_id` (NULL on every row) and the tenant wall hides it | the target's own declarations already say what is safe: `managedBy: 'better-auth'` ("extra columns would collide") and `protection.lock: 'full'` ("no safe extension point at all"), enforced today only at the metadata save and delete doors | the reach is any package that extends a better-auth-managed identity object: cloud's `service-tenant` extends `sys_organization` (objectstack-ai/cloud#3014), and apps commonly add fields to `sys_user`
Thread-read: 6249622581
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs' file lists and the `pm:dispatched` claims were read at this claim. No open PR touches `registry.ts`, the injected-columns plan or `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/`. #24271 (`domain:services`, the same object's `actions` block) has closed.

Dispatch · `domain:engine` seat 1 · `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy` · 2026-10-18T14:03Z: `mode:cloud`. The dev session is `session_01GJL9Zar94zzHuG5XV78dUM`. It builds at the default tier on branch `claude/issue-24314-extension-of-managed-object`, claim 6250813213.

- **Carried:** triage 6249622581 (p1 `target:v18`; measure `sys_user` in the same round; the route is the lane's, by the four axes) and the card's Wanted.
- **Measured first, on a booted multi-tenant kernel:** an extension of `sys_organization` and of `sys_user`. That covers the merged system columns, the physical columns, the owner's and a member's reads, and the control.
- **The route:** settled by measurement. The seat's hypothesis is the loud refusal at registration. Both targets declare `protection.lock: 'full'` ("no safe extension point at all"; `no-overlay` is the value for extensible objects) and `managedBy: 'better-auth'`, under which the extension's own fields would also become columns on better-auth's table. The other route, inheriting the target's injection plan, is measured before it is rejected.
- **Blast radius:** every in-repo extender of a locked identity object is listed, a probe moves to a non-locked target, and cloud's `service-tenant` (objectstack-ai/cloud#3014) gets a consumer pointer with its pin constraint.
- **Delivery:** a draft PR saying `Fixes #24314`, then an `os-dev-report` comment here. The seat owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue.
